During the [[Waymancy Storm]], a '''massacre''' occurred at [[Sooncanoo Beacon]]. The event resulted in the entire [[Fortieth Flotilla]] slaughtered by the [[Whirl-Point-Six]] mercenary band after a gambit by the latter to boost their shields failed.
